run_generate: run the FlaxWhisperForConditionalGeneration generate method to transcribe audio input features into text tokens
run_decode: run the FlaxWhisperForConditionalGeneration decode method to generate logits from decoder input IDs and encoder outputs
run_encode: run the FlaxWhisperPreTrainedModel encode method to extract encoder hidden states from audio input features
build_scan_params: build scanned model parameters by converting unrolled encoder and decoder layer weights into a single stacked block
test_init_cache: test the init_cache method to pre-compute key and value hidden-states for fast autoregressive decoding
